newsitem.title: USA: San Juan 540 MW coal-fired unit back to full power.
newsitem.headline: San Juan 540 MW coal-fired unit back to full power.

text.p: The 540 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the San Juan coal-fired power plant in New Mexico was back to full power Wednesday night after being shut last weekend due to a boiler tube leak, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Thursday.
San Juan's 350 MW unit 2 has been down since early this month for maintenance scheduled to finish by May 5.
The plant's second 350 MW unit and another 540 MW unit were said to be operating normally.
The power plant is operated by Public Service Co of New Mexico.
